description: Sri Lanka  Customs - Notify the Rates of Exchange effective from 22.10.2018 to 28.10.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically determining how customs valuations and payments should be calculated. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it involves statutory instruments and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
